extract_batch: handles unsupported MIME gracefully

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() = kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper()
    val configDefault = mapper.readValue("{\"url\":{\"crawl\":{\"ssrf\":{}}}}", ExtractionConfig::class.java)
    val result = Xberg.extractBatch(listOf(mapper.readValue("{\"bytes\":[80,68,70,32,112,108,97,99,101,104,111,108,100,101,114],\"kind\":\"bytes\",\"mime_type\":\"application/x-unknown\"}", ExtractInput::class.java)), configDefault)
    println(result)
}
```
